prompt:
The snippet snippets/age-gate.liquid has syntax errors and incomplete logic. Rewrite it so it parses under strict Liquid and renders an age verification gate. Inputs (all top-level, always supplied): - `age_gate`: object, never null, with keys: - `age_gate.enabled`: boolean - `age_gate.minimum_age`: integer or null (null means 18) - `age_gate.heading`: string or null - `customer_age`: integer or null (null means the age is unknown) - `age_verified`: boolean Rules, in order of precedence: 1. If `age_gate.enabled` is false, output nothing. 2. If `age_verified` is true, output nothing (even when customer_age is below the minimum). 3. MIN is minimum_age, or 18 when it is null. HEADING is the heading with surrounding whitespace stripped; if the heading is null or empty after stripping, HEADING is `Age verification`. HEADING is always HTML-escaped with the escape filter. 4. If customer_age is null, output exactly: `

HEADING

You must be MIN or older to enter this store.

` 5. Else if customer_age is less than MIN, let W = MIN minus customer_age and output exactly: `

HEADING

Sorry, you must be MIN or older to enter. Come back in W UNIT.

` where UNIT is `year` when W is 1, otherwise `years`. 6. Otherwise (customer_age is greater than or equal to MIN) output nothing. No whitespace between or around tags and no leading or trailing whitespace in the output. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/age-gate.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
